cohort: 300 neonates born at a maternity home over a six-month period.
finding: The prevalence of neonatal jaundice was 31.3%, and it was significantly associated with prematurity, maternal age, parity, gravida, breastfeeding, and maternal medical history.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with neonatal jaundice.
gest_age: Preterm and full-term neonates were included (specific gestational ages not provided).
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured, but specific ranges or categories are not given.
